eligibility.quote: Reporter's reproducer (PX4 SITL in Gazebo, lidar model rotated 0.785398163 rad, mavros distance_sensor config) and log "[ERROR] [1641489853.571286350, 184.549000000]: SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688); with orientation YAW_45 in the config: "DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240). Maintainer confirmation: "I found bug in enum_sensor_orientation.cpp introduced by CUSTOM entry." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1008431926) and on the remaining mismatch: "You have to modify simulator code to send different orientation because mavros plugin just checks if it matches config (like sanity check)." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1011160733).

failed_conditions.quote: But normally is should be recognized as YAW_45 and indeed I get the error message `DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (CUSTOM) than in config (YAW_45)!`. Any clue to solve this ?
I found bug in enum_sensor_orientation.cpp introduced by CUSTOM entry.

loudness.quote: mavros's distance_sensor plugin enforces its configured orientation at run time and refuses the reading with an error: "DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240); the plugin code returns before publishing on this check ("return;" after the ROS_ERROR_NAMED in handle_distance_sensor). The internal lookup defect also logs "SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100".

resolution.quote: The reporter rebuilt master and saw the lookup error disappear: "I've built master and I don't get the `SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100` message anymore. My sensor orientation is now recognized as CUSTOM and it seems to be working." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1010921466), but the configuration used for that observation is not stated, the YAW_45 configuration still failed, and the PX4 revision is known only as "latest"; the reporter's last reply is "Ok thanks !" without a further test (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1011186558).

notes: Adjudicated case C3-048: fully agrees with specification eligibility (E1-E4 step 6), failed conditions, loudness (loud_documented), and resolution status (recommended).
